limitations: All 30 additions come from one community/platform, across 20 conservative source groups; this is not a representative production sample.
Public attachment dimensions do not establish native resolution, DPI or original capture date. Every exact client version stays null.
All 51 older images have been inspected during prior work; none enters the new untouched test partition.
Four partially clipped Hit Points values are unambiguously readable from their surviving glyphs; three other rows in each are N/A. A separate severely clipped Hit Points fragment is N/A.
Static screenshot repetitions do not establish live freshness, capture latency, layout recovery or production error rates.
No screenshot is excluded or relabeled because a reader fails. Future failure-driven tuning must use development images; test-derived tuning requires fresh test evidence.
Cached latency is conditional on successful discovery. Missing layouts do not count as fast successful reads.
One run per image/variant; 50 repeats measure warm static behavior, not independent gameplay samples.
